item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. With the subtropical ridge extending westwards in the middle and latter parts of this week, it will be generally fine and very hot over the coast of southern China. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong over the weekend and early next week.
